findings.result: Intro preserves one-shot vs repeating, no adjustment for overhead, rearming relative to cached now; now update before timer callbacks/after I/O wakeup with uv_update_time reference.
Example preserves50ms interval,17ms callback,33ms remainder and callback as soon as possible when other tasks overrun; no claim of exact guaranteed real-time deadline.
Both type definitions and all7 functions preserved, including parameter types/constness. timeout/repeat milliseconds, zero timeout ->next loop iteration; nonzero repeat first timeout then repeat.
start does not update cached now and already-active timer is updated. stop means no future callback. again stops/restarts repeating timer using repeat as timeout, never-started ->UV_EINVAL.

set_repeat preserves interval independent of callback duration and normal semantics on overrun. Callback-setting is NOT immediate: one-shot already stopped; repeating next timeout already scheduled with old repeat value.
get_repeat and get_due_in retained; expired ->0, time relative uv_now and added1.40.0. Inherited handle members/API preserved.

readability: Complete Japanese explanations; callback/thread and repeat/timeout terms consistent. Conditional and exception statements retain scope without added guarantees.
footer: Fixed version/commit/CC BY4.0 and original notices/editable RST retained in footer; unofficial translation clear, no process approval language in body.
